facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹18,434 cr, +34% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹2,258 cr, −29% on the prior twelve months.
Sep 2026 quarter: revenue ₹4,876 cr (+26% YoY), PAT ₹394 cr (−69% YoY), operating margin 14.8%.
Revenue has compounded at 6% over 10 years, 38% over 5 and 41% over 3; the last twelve months (+34%) are running behind the 3-year pace.
Profit has compounded faster than revenue over 3 years (163% vs 41%): operating leverage is working.
Operating margin has compressed to 14.8% from 18.6% a year ago (−3.8 pp).
Annual operating margin has ranged from 14% to 18% over five years; the latest year (18%) sits at the top of that range.
Borrowings are ₹673 cr against equity of ₹10,277 cr: debt/equity 0.07× (was 1.76× in Mar 2023).
Operating profit plus other income covers interest 6.3× over the last twelve months.
The cash conversion cycle has shortened to 117 days from 162 in Mar 2023 (payable days 86 → 172, debtor days 72 → 137).
Promoters hold 11.7%, unchanged over a year.
Over 5 years, ₹4,167 cr of operating cash came from ₹7,658 cr of operating profit: 54% conversion; against PAT of ₹8,605 cr that is 0.5×.
Free cash flow was negative in 1 of the last 5 years; cumulative ₹2,906 cr, latest year ₹626 cr.
Capex ran at 3% of revenue in Mar 2026, about ₹576 cr (averaged 2% over the three years before).

business.what: Suzlon Energy Ltd is a leading player in the wind industry. It generates revenue primarily through the manufacturing and sale of Wind Turbine Generators (WTG), providing Operation and Maintenance Services (OMS), and foundry and forging operations.
